description: Kaplan-Meier survival + log-rank — Offline survival / time-to-event analysis (churn, time to failure, time to conversion, clinical follow-up). times= comma list where a trailing + marks a censored observation (e.g. 12+), or pass events= 1/0 flags; groups=NAME:t1,t2+,..;NAME2:.. (2-10 groups) instead of times= to compare curves. Returns the Kaplan-Meier table with Greenwood SE and log(-log) confidence bands, median + CI, quartiles, restricted mean survival time (tau= default = shortest group max time), survival at= chosen times, and for groups the log-rank chi-square, p-value, observed/expected and (2 groups) Peto hazard ratio with CI. confidence=80|90|95|99. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_survival
